content:
Priya (People Ops): quick follow-up from today’s all-hands on hiring/org changes. dropping this thread for Q&A. please keep questions short and we’ll reply. :seedling:
Alex (CEO): TL;DR: we approved +18 hires over Q2/Q3 to accelerate the runtime roadmap and shore up Dedicated SLAs. will post a detailed tracker.
Sam (Recruiter): We’re opening reqs tomorrow. if you have referrals, DM me with resume + 2-sentence who/why.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Breakdown? slides were fuzzy.
Alex (CEO): Rough split: 9 runtime (eng-runtime/eng-ml), 4 eng-sre, 3 product (PM/PMM mix), 2 security. numbers flexible.
Rina (Eng Director): For runtime hires, are we prioritizing model infra or inference kernel work?
Alex (CEO): Mostly inference/kernel work (latency, batching, quantization), but 1-2 roles will be focused on model-onboarding automation.
Maya (Product): The 3 product roles 1:1 PM to PMM?
Priya (People Ops): Two PMs, one PMM. PMs are Senior level. JDs up tonight.
Ken (Finance): Note: hiring assumes baseline ARR growth. if bookings dip significantly, we pause hiring and re-evaluate.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Interviewing cadence? will we allow hiring managers to set panel composition?
Sam (Recruiter): Standard: 3-stage funnel (screen -> technical loop -> final). hiring managers pick panelists from the allowed pool; include at least one cross-functional reviewer for platform-facing roles.
Hiring Bot: Headcount sheet updated: https://internal.redwood/sheets/hc-plan-2171002222 (managers: edit, org: read).
Priya (People Ops): Internal transfer window will be open for 7 calendar days after reqs publish. process in short:
```
- manager expresses interest (via form)
- candidate discussion + interview waiver if applicable
- joint approval from current + new manager + People Ops
```
Rina (Eng Director): Are TL slots being backfilled by promotions or external hires?
Priya (People Ops): Mix. we expect 2 internal promotions to TL and 1 external hire for immediate capacity. promotion criteria will be posted.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Compensation bands? market seems pricey for runtime folks.
Ken (Finance): Bands nudged up for eng-runtime; expect ranges + map to levels published alongside JDs. equity refresh conversation will follow for senior hires.
Maya (Product): Remote candidates 1 visa/relocation support?
Sam (Recruiter): We are open to remote within NA/EU. Visa sponsorship limited and reserved for high-priority senior roles; relocation considered case-by-case.
Alex (CEO): We want to hire fast but deliberately. don’t rush panels without calibration. we’ll run calibration sessions next week for runtime interviews.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Ramp expectations? how long until new hires oncall for Dedicated?
Priya (People Ops): Typical ramp: 6-10 weeks to take light oncall, 3 months for full rotation. we’ll provide pairing and shadow shifts.
Ken (Finance): Short-term mitigation for oncall: budget for contractors (0.5 FTE) and temporary overtime stipends.
Maya (Product): Any org chart changes now or later?
Alex (CEO): Small realignment: creating a Runtime Platform team that sits between eng-runtime and eng-platform to improve ownership boundaries. full chart next Tuesday.
Jordan (Eng Manager): Does the new team change reporting for current TLs?
Alex (CEO): Minimal disruptions. some TLs may report into the new Director-level role; we’ll consult individually.
Sam (Recruiter): Action items: 1) JDs posted tonight, 2) internal transfer window opens tomorrow, 3) calibration + panel signup next Wed.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks everyone. post any follow-ups here. we’ll close thread after org chart + JD links are live. :white_check_mark:
